method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the seat of the declarant and of the person asked to witness. Where the Act applies (ss 5, 13, Endnote 5); anyone may declare about any matter and what a declaration may be used for, with the judicial-proceedings carve-out (s 6); signing by hand or electronically (s 7A); the two routes of s 8: observation by a prescribed person in person or by video link, with the witness signing the declaration or a true copy (s 9), and digital verification on an approved online platform with an approved identity service (s 9A); what the witness may do and must sign (s 9); the platform may not keep a copy (s 9B(1)); a declaration another Commonwealth law requires before a named person (s 10); the false-statement offence and its 4-year maximum (s 11); from the Regulations, who is a prescribed person (reg 6, Schedule 1 Parts 1 and 2), the verification condition (reg 7), the platform information (reg 8), myGov (reg 9) and the identity service (reg 10). Not encoded: the 1911 saving (s 3), references in other laws (s 7) beyond s 10, platform reports (s 9B(2)-(5)), courts (s 12), regulations, forms and review (ss 14-16); Criminal Code Chapter 2 (not deposited; the fault element for falsity is an input); conversion of the prison term to a fine.
seat: the declarant, and the person asked to witness the declaration
